limitations: Unweighted mixed-arm spiders with p>=1 short arms and q>=2 two-edge arms only, in the canonical zero-sum Euclidean realization; no weighted-tree or arbitrary-Hilbert-isomorphism result. Optimal-center affine dimensions but not full center-polytope face lattices are determined. Historical priority under a different formulation cannot be guaranteed.
title: Exact Euclidean inballs and center ranks for mixed-arm spider free spaces
